*Originally announced [here](https://erwinlares.github.io/the-burrows/events/2026-07-07-soft-opening.html)

## Details

- **Date:** Tuesday, July 7, 2026
- **Time:** 1:00 – 2:30 PM
- **Location:** CS 3139, Computer Science Building, UW–Madison
- **Notes by:** Jayden Merrick

## Who was there

A genuinely mixed crowd of about ten — researchers, faculty, staff researchers, data
analysts, grad students, and undergrads, all trading resources and ideas in the same
room. Several attendees mentioned they'd bring PIs and colleagues along to future
meetings.

## Show and Tell

John La Plante from Posit introduced Positron and Posit's enterprise products. 

## Decisions made

- Meetings will happen monthly going forward.
- The next meeting will focus on learning about our website — The Burrows — how to carry out a pull request to collaborate, share resources, and share content in general. 

## Open suggestions

- Post directions to the meeting room for people unfamiliar with the building.
- Consider a GitLab wiki for troubleshooting/resources, linked from The Burrows.
  *(Followed up: BRUG is staying with GitHub Discussions for now — see the
  [Discussions](/discussions/index.qmd) page for the reasoning.)*
- Whether to add Slack, expand the Google Group, or use social media — including a
  possible joint Badger BioData/BRUG account to reach undergrads separately from
  post-graduate members.
- Collaborate with other UW–Madison communities of practice (Data Wonks, Data Science
  Hub Code Meeting, and others).

## Connections & outreach

- Badger BioData, an undergraduate R/data club, is actively building its own Quarto
  site modeled on The Burrows.
- The Badger Data Network reached out shortly after the soft opening asking to be
  added to the site — an early sign of the Wisconsin Idea's "propagate outward" part
  working as intended.

## Next meeting

- **Date:** Pending vote — poll sent for Tuesday, August 4
- **Time:** 1:30 – 2:30 PM (proposed recurring slot: first Tuesday of the month)
- **Location:** Same room, already reserved
- **Planned focus:** Package-focused workshop; also a good chance to walk everyone
  through using the website
